title: Resonance
oneliner: A fast twin-stick action game. Use your telekinetic voice to lift and control objects and enemies, allowing you to shield yourself and fight! Escape the facility trying to keep you under its control.
responsibilities: Developed a complete and polished level design for the final product.
Scripted various level ingredients to create intended gameplay situations.
Developed several prototypes to search for gameplay beats fitting the player experience.

title: Prohibition Time
oneliner: An online multiplayer game. The game combines elements of the social deduction game “Mafia” (also known as “Werewolf”) extended by our team with cards and special actions.
responsibilities: Designed backend architecture with multiple game states, player actions and multiplayer communication.
Created a state machine responsible for handling numerous game states.
Interpreted tabletop game rules into video game format.

title: Moonsoup
oneliner: A 2D simulator game about running a potion shop set in a medieval fantasy setting. The game combines logical puzzles and mini-games in a design that focuses on creating a casual and relaxing gameplay.
responsibilities: Designed and created gardening system, a variety of minigames, dialogue system and quest system.
Integrated the systems of the game to create a cohesive gameplay experience.
Collaborated with other developers on creating the key system of the game.

title: Keep Talking and Nobody Gets Murdered
oneliner: A 2-player asymetrical coop game where one players is banquet infiltrator in VR, while the other looks from above and provides information and clues.
responsibilities: Designed two players' gameplays sharing identical goals, but have limited sets information each.
Designed for a VR experience, creating gameplay elements that leadn into tactility, exploration and communication between the players.
Developed a full experience under 48 hour limit.

title: When the Dusk Comes
oneliner: A 2D clicker game where the player tries to shelter people before the apocalypse. The game combines button clicking with systems for saving humanity, heritage, and technology trees.
responsibilities: Designed systems and gameplay elements around a singular core mechanic of button clicking.
Concepted a coherent vision with a team in 2 hours.
Developed a full experience under 24 hour limit.

title: Coal in my Heart
oneliner: A 2D side-scrolling platformer game that mixes a fighting system with survival mechanics. The player has to fight swarms of living icicles and snowflakes to reach the heating system, guarded by a boss who must be defeated to fix it.
responsibilities: Designed two types of enemies, each with a unique behavior, and a boss fight consisting of three phases.
Created a platforming traversal system with multiple abilities and simple combat.
Developed the full experience as a solo developer.
